The '''Terreene Brainiac''' was a model of [[Supervisor droid/Legends|control droid]]. The [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] was rather naive when it came to organic interaction and could be conned, but it learned quickly that they were being deceived. [[Control (droid)|Control]], a control droid charged with running the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial mining complex|mobile mining complex]] on [[Alabash]] was a Terreene Brainiac.<ref name="Freedom" />
